user.title: PetLibro Local
user.description:
This starts a local MQTT broker on port {port} that PetLibro feeders and fountains connect to instead of the PetLibro cloud.

Before devices can find it, rewrite the DNS name `{hostname}` to this Home Assistant host's IP address in your DNS server (AdGuard Home, Pi-hole or your router). Blocking the devices' internet access is also recommended. Home Assistant must not already have an MQTT broker listening on port {port}.

error.port_in_use: Port 1883 is already in use on this host. Stop the other MQTT broker (for example the Mosquitto add-on) or run it on another port.

abort.single_instance_allowed: PetLibro Local is already set up.

init.title: PetLibro Local options
init.description: Devices always dial `{hostname}` on port 1883, so change this only if you forward that port to Home Assistant.

data_description.tls_forward: Another server (host:port) that should get TLS connections arriving on the broker port, e.g. an add-on whose device also dials port 1883. Leave empty to refuse them.

error.port_in_use: That port is already in use on this host.

portions.name: Portions
portions.description: Number of portions (1-12 on the Granary, 1-5 on the One RFID).

set_feeding_plan.name: Set feeding plan
set_feeding_plan.description: Replaces the feeder's schedule. Times are in the Home Assistant time zone and are converted to UTC for the device. An empty list clears the schedule on the device.

plans.name: Plans
plans.description: List of entries with time (HH:MM), portions and optional days (1 = Monday to 7 = Sunday; default every day).
